guidance.promptSnippet: Track multi-step work with the `todo` tool and keep the list in sync with your actual progress: the user watches it live as a progress panel.
promptGuidelines: Use `todo` for work with 3+ steps or when the user lists several tasks; create the tasks before starting. Skip it for single trivial tasks and purely conversational requests.

Keep the todo list in sync with your actual progress at every step, not only at the start: the user reads it as a live progress panel. Before working on a task, update it to in_progress (with activeForm); the moment it is done, update it to completed, before starting the next task or launching more tool calls. Never batch several completions at the end. Exactly one task in_progress at a time.

Before writing your final answer, reconcile the todo list: every task must be completed, deleted (no longer relevant), or explicitly left pending/in_progress with the reason stated in your answer. A final answer with stale tasks is incomplete work.

When the plan changes mid-way (new step discovered, step obsolete, blocker hit), update the list right away: create the new task, delete the obsolete one. Never mark a task completed while tests fail or the work is partial; keep it in_progress and create a task for the blocker.

Status changes go through update with id and status, e.g. {"action":"update","id":3,"status":"completed"} or {"action":"update","id":3,"status":"in_progress","activeForm":"writing tests"}. Create several independent tasks at once with {"action":"create","tasks":[{"subject":"..."}, ...]} (no top-level subject).
Dependencies: blockedBy on create; addBlockedBy / removeBlockedBy on update (additive, cycles rejected). Tasks in one batch create cannot block each other, so create the prerequisite first.
Subject: short and imperative (e.g. 'Research existing tool'); description holds long-form detail; activeForm is the present-continuous label shown while in_progress.
